title: The bootstrap connection's enrollment through the identity provider
spec: Enroller::with_external(provider) makes a server enroll through its identity provider (ExternalEnrollment: begin and verify). RedeemExternal takes Redeem's checks and limits with no password, stages the device, calls begin (with no lock held through receive_shared) and answers ExternalStart with nothing durable (ERR_UNAVAILABLE and nothing staged if begin fails). ConfirmExternal on the same attempt takes the limits, calls verify (no lock held), requires the token's email to normalize to the invitation's (ERR_EXTERNAL_REFUSED otherwise, nothing durable, the attempt dropped, the invitation live), then commits ONE record with the binding (ActivationRecord::external; no password; a TOTP secret no one is shown) and only then sends Activated. A server with a provider refuses Redeem, and one without refuses RedeemExternal, with ERR_WRONG_PATH. Out-of-order requests close without a reply.
